name: 流式审核抽检 — 任务管理页面抽检状态展示
description: 验证任务管理页面中，流式抽检拦截任务的状态展示（待抽检/抽检中）、抽检进度、正确率统计。

steps.description: 验证任务管理页面已加载

steps.expression: (() => { const text = document.body.innerText; const hasInspectionStatus = text.includes('待抽检') || text.includes('抽检中') || text.includes('抽检完成') || text.includes('HELD'); const hasStreamTask = text.includes('流式') || text.includes('STREAM'); const tableHeaders = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('th, .ant-table-column-title')).map(h => h.textContent.trim()); return { hasInspectionStatus, hasStreamTask, tableHeaders, pagePreview: text.substring(0, 500) }; })()
steps.description: 验证任务管理列表含抽检状态和流式任务标识

steps.expression: (() => { const detailBtns = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button, a, span')).filter(e => e.textContent.includes('查看详情') || e.textContent.includes('详情')); if (detailBtns[0]) { detailBtns[0].click(); return { clicked: true, text: detailBtns[0].textContent.trim() }; } return { clicked: false }; })()

(() => { const text = document.body.innerText; const hasStats = text.includes('正确率') || text.includes('一致率') || text.includes('通过率') || text.includes('抽检进度'); const hasFilter = text.includes('任务状态') || text.includes('审核状态'); return { hasStats, hasFilter, pagePreview: text.substring(0, 500) }; })()
steps.description: 验证任务详情含抽检统计信息

_testDesign.preconditions: F88预发环境可访问；任务管理页面存在流式抽检相关任务
_testDesign.stepsText: 1.打开任务管理 2.验证列表含抽检状态 3.点击详情 4.验证抽检统计
_testDesign.expectedResult: 任务管理页面正确展示流式抽检任务状态和统计
riskPoints: 流式抽检任务可能尚未产生
_testDesign.prdMapping: 覆盖任务类型 + 正确率统计
